meaning/line.why: Control with identical text: both say same, 0, same thing.

meaning/minute.why: Both say same/0, but X's reason invents a detail, 'the engine omitted the comma after reads'; both texts have 'reads,'.

noticeable.why: There is nothing to notice. X says no, Y says yes.

stakes.why: Both say no, but X's reason again invents a punctuation difference that is not there.

rule.why: Both say the rule is wrong; X names the claimed 'leads'.

blind.why: The two versions are identical. X says can't tell in both orders. Y says they are identical but picks Version A both times.

misses.why: Both give an empty list, which is right.

overall.why: On the copy control, X gets noticeable and blind right; Y calls an identical text noticeably wrong and picks a side anyway. X's invented comma is a smaller fault.
